svg.aria-label: Graphic placement schematic for an ACG Dri-FIT tee concept, Lagazuoi Year Two, size M base: front colorway flat, back view, line art, repeat tile, graphic detail and colorways
svg.text: GRAPHIC PLACEMENT SCHEMATIC
ACG DRI-FIT TEE, LOOSE · LAGAZUOI, YEAR TWO · CONCEPT FOR NEXT SEASON · SIZE M BASE · ALL DIMENSIONS IN INCHES · DRAWN TO SCALE
FRONT · COLORWAY 1
Across shoulder 20.5
Chest 44 (1 in below armhole, loose fit)
Hem width 44, straight hem
Body length 29 (HPS)
CF
3.5 from CF
3 from HPS
Left chest: ACG mark, 1.25 x 1.1, high-density heat transfer, matte white
Center 3 in below HPS, 3.5 in from CF. Placement tolerance +/- 0.25
Sleeve 9 from shoulder seam
Sleeve opening 9 flat
1 in hem, double-needle coverstitch
Bottom hem 1 in, double-needle coverstitch
2 in
Neck: 7/8 in 1x1 rib, self fabric, black. Width 7.5, front drop 3.25
Allover print, two inks
Ink A contour linework, green, 1.0 to 1.5 mm line weight
Ink B tunnel route, portals and summit marker, bone
Repeat 12 x 12, rotary screen on open-width fabric before cutting
Free match at seams, print direction up, see tile below
Water-based ink, soft hand, no cracking after 20 washes
Drop shoulder, flatlock seam
Side seam: flatlock, no vents, pattern free match
Fabric
Dri-FIT jersey, 63% polyester / 37% cotton, 200 gsm, black
Loose fit: 3 in ease over Nike M body chest 41
Tolerance +/- 0.5 unless noted.
Graded spec XS to 4XL Tall. Tall adds 1.75 to body length.
BACK
Back neck hit: LAGAZUOI · 2778 M, 3.5 x 0.5
one color, Ink B screen print, 1.5 in below CB seam
Interior: tagless size and care at CB neck
ACG woven label 1.25 x 0.5, left hem, 1 in from side seam
Care label: left interior side seam, 2 in below armhole
Across back 20.5
LINE ART · FRONT
Half chest 22 flat
Outline flat for the pattern room and the factory
Chest hit placement box shown dashed
Seams: shoulder, armhole, side, sleeve and bottom hems
ALLOVER REPEAT TILE
12 x 12 in tile, shown at 1:4
Contours: Monte Lagazuoi, simplified from map data
Route: the tunnel network, dashed, portal rings
Summit marker at 2778 m
Year one printed the tunnels. Year two prints the view.
GRAPHIC DETAIL · 2:1
Ink A line weight 1.0 to 1.5 mm, no fills
Ink B route 1.8 mm, dash 6 mm, gap 4 mm
Portal ring 6 mm outside diameter
Trap 0.3 mm where B crosses A
COLORWAYS
CW1 Black / Green / Bone
CW2 Light Bone / Pine / Black
Body PANTONE 19-4005 TCX · Ink A matched to current ACG Cave Dweller green · Ink B PANTONE 11-0105 TCX
